'''''The Approaching Storm''''' is the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] prologue novel to the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']]. It was written by [[Alan Dean Foster]] and first published by [[Del Rey]] in hardcover on [[January 29]], [[2002]]. The first paperback edition was released in [[January]] [[2003]].
